source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Morgan's discovery of sex linkage and the Embryonic Screening box (PDF 105-106).

blocks.text: 1910 mein Thomas Hunt Morgan ko aik nar Drosophila mili jis ki aankhein normal surkh ke bajaye safaid theen. Us ne is mutant nar ko normal (wild-type) surkh aankh wali maada se milaya aur sab F1 makkhiyon ki aankhein surkh theen, is liye surkh safaid par dominant tha.

Phir us ne surkh aankh wali F1 makkhiyan aapas mein milayin. Kitab F2 mein 3473 surkh aankh wali (nar aur maada) aur 782 safaid aankh wali makkhiyan batati hai, taqreeban 18%. Surkh aur safaid ki nisbat 3:1 se zyada thi, lekin ahem baat yeh thi ke sab safaid aankh wali F2 makkhiyan nar theen.

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein; har makkhi ke saath daire mein us ka sex chromosome jora. Walidain: safaid aankh nar XrY (safaid X par recessive allele r aur kunde jaisa Y baghair allele) x surkh aankh maada XRXR (do gehre surkh X par dominant allele R). F1: surkh aankh nar XRY x surkh aankh maada XRXr. F2: safaid aankh nar XrY, surkh aankh nar XRY, surkh aankh maada XRXr aur surkh aankh maada XRXR.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.14: Drosophila mein sex-linked khasiyat (aankh ka rang) ki virasat (kitab ki Figure 18.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: X-chromosome with recessive white-eye allele (r), Y-chromosome with no allele, X-chromosomes with dominant red-eye allele (R), Parents, F1 generation, F2 generation.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Safaid danda X par r (safaid aankh), gehra surkh danda X par R (surkh aankh), aur peela kunde wala danda Y hai jis par yeh gene nahi. Nar ke paas sirf aik X hai, is liye us ka aik r bhi safaid aankh deta hai; maada ko safaid aankh ke liye do r chahiye. F2 mein sirf nar (XrY) safaid aankh wala hai.

Yeh jaanchne ke liye ke kya safaid aankh wali maada ho sakti hai, Morgan ne F1 surkh aankh wali maada ka safaid aankh wale nar se testcross kiya aur safaid aur surkh aankh wale nar aur maada 1:1:1:1 mein paye, yaani maada ki aankhein safaid ho sakti hain. Phir us ne safaid aankh wali maada ko surkh aankh wale nar se milaya: sab betiyon ki aankhein surkh aur sab beton ki safaid theen.

blocks.title: Morgan ka nateeja
blocks.text: Safaid aankh ka gene X chromosome par hai, aur Y chromosome par is ka allele nahi. Morgan ne aise genes ko sex-linked genes aur khasiyaton ko sex-linked khasiyatein kaha.

blocks.title: Adaad ki jaanch
blocks.text: 3473 + 782 = 4255 hai, jab ke kitab kul 4252 chhapti hai; 782 dono majmooon ka taqreeban 18% hai.

blocks.prompt: Morgan ki sab safaid aankh wali F2 makkhiyan nar kyun nikleen?
blocks.explanation: F1 maada XR Xr aur F1 nar XR Y tha. Har beti ko baap ka XR mila, is liye sab surkh aankh wali; aadhe beton ko maa ka Xr mila aur doosra X na hone se un ki aankhein safaid hueen.

blocks.text: Embryonic screening un tareeqon ko kehte hain jo janeen mein genetic bimariyan aur chromosomes ki ghair maamooli tadaad jaanchte hain, jaise ultrasound scan, chorionic villus sampling aur amniocentesis.

Amniocentesis aam taur par hamal ke 15ven aur 20ven hafte ke darmiyan ki jati hai. Lambi sui amniotic theli mein dali jati hai jab ke ultrasound probe janeen ki jagah dhoondta hai; sui janeen ke cells wala thora amniotic mayi nikalti hai, jinhein culture medium mein rakh kar chromosomes ki ghair maamooli tadaad ke liye jaancha jata hai.

blocks.alt: Hamla aurat ke pait ka pehlu se kata hua hissa, neeche reerh ki haddi. Bachcha-daani mein janeen (foetus) amniotic mayi se bhari amniotic theli mein hai. Oopar jild par ultrasound probe rakha hai aur syringe ki sui pait ki deewar se amniotic theli mein jati hai. Teer janeen ke cells ke bare daire ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Amniocentesis (kitab ke Embryonic Screening box ke khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
